name: kob-mcp
description: Read and trade KOB order books on Kaspa through the kob CLI, within local spending limits. Testnet-10 by default.
long_description: The key stays on this computer and is read only by the kob CLI. Every write returns its plan first and sends only when the agent calls it again with the plan id; the agent confirms its own plans, so the limits are what holds. Per-transaction and per-day KAS caps, a fee cap, a cap on token creations per day, a withdrawal allow-list (your primary wallet), a kill switch file and an audit log are kept in the data folder.

network.title: Network
network.description: testnet-10 (mainnet also needs allowMainnet: true in a config file)

kob_cli.title: kob CLI
kob_cli.description: The kob binary (kob.exe on Windows) from a KOB release

key_file.title: Key file
key_file.description: A file holding the agent wallet's 64-hex key. Use a wallet only for the agent; only the kob CLI reads it.

withdraw_to.title: Primary wallet
withdraw_to.description: The only address kob_send may pay (comma-separate more than one)

per_tx_kas.title: Per-transaction cap (KAS)
per_tx_kas.description: The most KAS one transaction may take out of the wallet: escrow, carriers, sends and fee

per_day_kas.title: Per-day cap (KAS)
per_day_kas.description: The same over a UTC day

max_fee_kas.title: Fee cap (KAS)
max_fee_kas.description: The most network fee of one transaction

launches_per_day.title: Token creations per day
launches_per_day.description: The most kob_token_create calls that send per UTC day

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Ledger, audit log and the kill switch: create a file named STOP here to refuse every write

node.title: Node (optional)
node.description: A JSON wRPC URL such as ws://host:18210; needed to create tokens. Empty: the public nodes

config_file.title: Config file (optional)
config_file.description: A kob-mcp config.json for further settings (mode, price band, allowMainnet); the fields above win

tools.name: kob_status
tools.description: Wallet, network, limits, today's spend, kill switch

tools.name: kob_book
tools.description: A token's order book, as levels or single orders

tools.name: kob_fee_estimate
tools.description: A dry run of a write: fee, spend, limits

tools.name: kob_place_limit
tools.description: Place a limit order (plan, then confirm)

tools.name: kob_replace
tools.description: Amend a live order (plan, then confirm)

tools.name: kob_sweep
tools.description: Return the strays an order owns to the wallet (plan, then confirm)

tools.name: kob_take
tools.description: Take a resting order of a named token within a required price bound

tools.name: kob_claim
tools.description: Claim what a collected buy order bought

tools.name: kob_send
tools.description: Send KAS or a token to the primary wallet only
